parameters.query:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_approvals WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND approval_stage='analysis' AND decision='approved') AS allowed,
  '{{$json.job_id}}' AS job_id,
  '{{$json.mode}}' AS mode,
  ('{{$json.mode}}'='live') AS live_mode;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {model:($json.llm_model || "gpt-4o-mini"), messages:[{role:'system',content:"Generate a content plan only if analysis approval exists. Return strict JSON with strategy, outputs, dependencies, assumptions, and risks."},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify($json)}], response_format:{type:'json_object'}} }}
